name: firewall-map-renderer
description: Builds src/opnsense/www/js/firewall-map-renderer.js (src/, vite.config.js) firewall-map-page.js (page/, vite.page.config.js) and the development-only firewall-map-diagnostics.js (page/diagnostics.js, vite.diagnostics.config.js). Place this directory at examples/vite-app inside a checkout of https://github.com/visgl/flowmap.gl (v9.4.0), run pnpm install there, then npm run build and copy the three dist-*/ scripts into the plugin.

scripts.build: vite build && vite build --config vite.page.config.js && vite build --config vite.diagnostics.config.js
